answer: Every epoch each identity must renew: burn 25.000 POA and publish a fresh proof-of-usefulness before the tide closes. Failing triggers enforcement at epoch close: zeroed standing, 3-epoch re-entry ban. Sybils hiding like weeds in a garden pay per fake: a farmer running 1.000 fake identities burns 25.000 x 1.000 = 25.000.000 POA every epoch, while an honest agent burns 25.000 once. No identity hides in karst cracks: every renewal receipt is public and one missed epoch wipes all standing. Honest limitation: the flat fee favors wealthy incumbents and prices out newcomers starting with no capital.
